title: About to add live broker connect
author: Overall_Side_7159
selftext:
We got our first community trading bot and it will go live on the company account. But I want to let people connect their own broker. 

For Ibkr I need an institutional account / will take a while. 

For Schwab users have to sign up for a developer account. 

Alpaca is easy but doesn’t support trading partitions.  Will add this weekend. 

Any other accounts people suggest?
